title: GEISA Application Message Response v0.9.0
description: Canonical structure for GEISA application messaging per-request disposition payloads aligned to app-message.proto. The payload is serialized protobuf bytes carried as base64 in JSON examples.

request-id.description: Application request identifier used for correlation.

status.description: Platform disposition for the corresponding request-id (for example accepted, queued, rejected, permission-denied, quota-exceeded, unavailable, expired, or other).

status-text.description: Optional human-readable diagnostic or status text.

priority.description: ADM object 3600-style message priority for app-facing messaging.

description-type.description: ADM object 3600-style message description for app configuration or app data.

timestamp-ms.description: UTC epoch time in milliseconds when the message was created.

ttl-ms.description: Time-to-live in milliseconds for the message payload.

content-type.description: MIME type describing the opaque payload bytes.

payload-base64.description: Optional base64-encoded protobuf payload bytes associated with the per-request disposition.

geisa-app-message-rsp.$comment: Quota counters/usage values are not carried here; those are reported through Platform/App Status.
